from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys

home = Path.home()
bus_path = home / ".local/share/prediction-command-bus/command_bus_poller.py"
wake_dir = home / ".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_cont_bus", bus_path)
bus = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(bus)

parent = "CONT-" + ("a" * 24)
cmd = {
    "schema": "PREDICTION_BRIDGE_COMMAND_V1",
    "task_id": "DEV-PRED-CONT-INSTALLED-CHECK",
    "action": "BRIDGE_PING",
    "created_at_utc": "2026-10-02T16:00:00Z",
    "route_task_id": "SESSION-ROUTE-INSTALLED-CHECK",
    "live_trading": False,
    "paid_actions": False,
    "wallet_actions": False,
    "intelligence_tier": "C",
    "issuer": {"model": "GPT-5.6 Sol", "reasoning_level": "UNAVAILABLE_TO_RUNTIME"},
    "auto_continue": True,
    "parent_continuation_id": parent,
}
ok, reason = bus.validate_command(cmd)
assert ok and reason == "OK", (ok, reason)

sys.path.insert(0, str(wake_dir))
spec2 = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_cont_wake", wake_dir / "bridge_server.py")
wake = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2)
assert spec2.loader is not None
spec2.loader.exec_module(wake)

assert getattr(wake.Handler, "server_version", "") == "PredictionChatWake/1.2-continuation-v2"
assert hasattr(wake.base, "INFLIGHT"), "existing fail-closed inflight patch missing"
assert wake.base.release_lease is wake.continuation_release_lease
assert wake.base.oldest_event is wake.continuation_oldest_event

ids = wake.continuation.ids_for("SOURCE-" + ("x" * 140) + "-tail")
assert ids["continuation_id"].startswith("CONT-")
assert ids["expected_next_task_id"].startswith("DEV-PRED-CONT-NEXT-")

root = Path(os.environ["PRED_PROJECT_TEMP_ROOT"]) / "continuation-v2-installed"
data = root / "bridge"
sent = data / "sent"
routes = data / "routes"
outbox = data / "outbox"
states = root / "task-state"
for p in (sent, routes, outbox, states):
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wake.base.DATA_DIR = data
wake.base.SENT = sent
wake.base.ROUTES = routes
wake.base.OUTBOX = outbox
wake.TASK_STATE_DIR = states

source = "DEV-PRED-CONT-INSTALLED-SOURCE"
event_id = "installed-cont-event-001"
(states / f"{source}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "schema": "PREDICTION_COMMAND_BUS_TASK_STATE_V1",
    "task_id": source,
    "status": "DISPATCHED",
    "auto_continue": True,
}), encoding="utf-8")
(routes / f"{source}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "version": 2,
    "task_id": source,
    "chat_id": "chat-installed-cont-001",
    "consumer_id": None,
}), encoding="utf-8")
(sent / f"{event_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "event_id": event_id,
    "task_id": source,
    "message": "NIGHTSHIFT_WSL_RESULT_V1 task=DEV-PRED-CONT-INSTALLED-SOURCE status=PASS exit=0",
}), encoding="utf-8")

wake.continuation_release_lease(event_id)
records = list((data / "continuations").glob("CONT-*.json"))
assert len(records) == 1
record = json.loads(records[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert record["state"] == "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"
assert record["expected_next_task_id"].startswith("DEV-PRED-CONT-NEXT-")
assert record["expected_route_task_id"] == source

wake.continuation.maintain_for_chat(
    data_dir=data,
    task_state_dir=states,
    routes_dir=routes,
    outbox_dir=outbox,
    chat_id="chat-installed-cont-001",
    now=1000.0,
)
record = json.loads(records[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert record["state"] == "CONTINUE_SENT"
events = list(outbox.glob("*.json"))
assert len(events) == 1
attempt = json.loads(events[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert attempt["continuation_id"] == record["continuation_id"]
assert "Browser send/ACK is not success" in attempt["message"]
assert f"route_task_id={source}" in attempt["message"]

print("CONTINUATION_V2_INSTALLED=PASS")
print("WAKE_HANDLER=" + wake.Handler.server_version)
print("INFLIGHT_PATCH=PRESERVED")
print("COMMAND_BUS_METADATA=PASS")
print("ACK_HOOK=PASS")
print("RETRY_EVENT=PASS")
